UserPromptSubmit.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${TOKENOMICS_ROOT}/scripts/controller.ts" prompt vscode

PreToolUse.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${TOKENOMICS_ROOT}/scripts/blinkers.ts" guard vscode

PostToolUse.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${TOKENOMICS_ROOT}/scripts/spendlens.ts" tool vscode

Stop.windows: $n = Get-Content "$HOME/.tokenomics/node" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $n) { $n = "node" }; & $n --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning "${TOKENOMICS_ROOT}/scripts/spendlens.ts" finalize vscode
